entities.name: Archaeal ribosomal protein eS27
observations: 66 aa acidic/ basic composition: predicted mass 7.32 kDa, pI 9.97, and net charge +8.46 at pH 7.
Exact sequence match (100% identity, 100% coverage) to reviewed UniProt Q4J9B1 from Sulfolobus acidocaldarius.
Curated annotations assign zinc ion binding and structural constituent of the small ribosomal subunit.
Localized to the cytoplasm in a close archaeal homolog (Q97Z80).

entities.name: 30S ribosomal subunit
observations: The protein is a component of the archaeal small ribosomal subunit and binds small-subunit rRNA according to a close homolog annotation.
The associated cellular compartment is the cytoplasmic ribosome.

entities.name: Translation
observations: The protein participates in translation as a structural constituent of the small ribosomal subunit.

entities.name: rRNA processing
observations: A close archaeal homolog is annotated as participating in rRNA processing; this process assignment is less direct than the conserved ribosomal structural role.

entities.name: Zinc ion binding
observations: The conserved Cys-rich motif is annotated as zinc ion binding in reviewed archaeal eS27 proteins.
